Adriana Reami (born November 13, 1997) is an American tennis player. Reami has a career-high singles ranking by the WTA of 359, achieved November 2022. She also has a career-high WTA doubles ranking of 225, reached on 22 May 2023. [ 1 ] Reami won her first $60k title at the 2022 Caldas da Rainha Ladies Open in the doubles draw, partnering Anna Rogers . Reami played college tennis at the NC State .
